sources.title: Windows에서 Wi-Fi 네트워크에 연결 | Microsoft Support
sources.body: Windows 11 현재 연결된 네트워크: 설정 앱에서 네트워크 & 인터넷 > 속성 > Wi-Fi 네트워크 암호 옆에 있는 표시를 선택하여 암호를 확인할 수 있습니다. Windows 11 알려진 네트워크: 네트워크 & 인터넷 > Wi-Fi > 알려진 네트워크 관리 페이지에서 네트워크를 선택한 다음 Wi-Fi 네트워크 암호 옆에 표시를 선택하여 저장된 네트워크의 암호를 볼 수 있습니다. Wi-Fi 네트워크 암호를 잊어버린 경우 다른 Windows 디바이스가 이미 Wi-Fi 네트워크에 연결되어 있는 경우 찾을 수 있으며, 암호를 찾은 후 다른 디바이스에서 암호를 사용하여 Wi-Fi 네트워크에 연결할 수 있습니다. Windows 10: 설정 앱에서 네트워크 & Internet > 상태 > 네트워크 및 공유 센터 선택, 연결 옆에 있는 Wi-Fi 네트워크 이름을 선택, Wi-Fi 상태에서 무선 속성 선택, 무선 네트워크 속성에서 보안 탭을 선택한 다음 문자 표시 검사 상자를 선택. QR 코드 연결(Windows 11): 카메라 앱에서 바코드 모드 아이콘을 선택하여 사진 모드에서 바코드 모드로 전환하고 QR 코드를 스캔.
facts: Windows 11: 네트워크 & 인터넷 > 속성 > Wi-Fi 네트워크 암호 옆 표시
Windows 11: 네트워크 & 인터넷 > Wi-Fi > 알려진 네트워크 관리에서 저장된 네트워크 암호 보기
Windows 10: 네트워크 및 공유 센터 > 무선 속성 > 보안 탭 > 문자 표시

sources.title: Find your Wi-Fi network password in Windows - Microsoft Support
sources.body: Finding Your Wi-Fi Password: To locate a saved password on your Windows device: In Settings, select Network & internet > Properties, then next to Wi-Fi network password, select Show. You can then share this password or use it on another device. QR Code Connection Method: Open the Camera app and switch to barcode mode. Point your camera at the Wi-Fi QR code. Select the link that appears to open Settings. Confirm adding and connecting to the network. Random hardware addresses: Settings > Network & internet > Wi-Fi and turn on Random hardware addresses.
facts: Windows 11 Settings > Network & internet > Properties > next to Wi-Fi network password select Show
Windows camera app barcode mode can scan Wi-Fi QR code

sources.title: netsh wlan | Microsoft Learn
sources.body: The netsh wlan command enables administrators to configure, manage, and troubleshoot wireless networking on Windows. Syntax includes netsh wlan show profiles. show: profiles - Lists all configured wireless network profiles. export profile: key: To display the security key in plain text, use key=clear. If the key parameter is set to plain text and the caller is a local administrator, the XML file includes the key in plain text. Otherwise, the key is encrypted in the output file. Example: netsh wlan export profile name="CorpWiFi" folder="C:\WiFiProfiles" key=clear
facts: netsh wlan show profiles lists all configured wireless network profiles
key=clear shows key in plain text only when caller is local administrator (export)

sources.title: Netsh Commands for Wireless Local Area Network (WLAN) in Windows Server 2008 R2 | Microsoft Learn
sources.body: show profiles: Displays a list of wireless profiles that are configured on the computer. Syntax: show profiles [[name=]ProfileName] [[interface=]InterfaceName] [[key=]clear]. key Optional. If specified, it must be in the form of key=clear. The word clear is not case sensitive. Any other string will be ignored. When specified, it means that if a key is present in the profile and the user has administrative privileges on the local computer, then the plain text key is displayed as part of the profile. If the name parameter is specified, then only the content for the specified profile is displayed. If the name parameter is not specified, only the profile name and description are displayed. Displayed information includes: Security settings - Number of auth/cipher combinations, Security key, 802.1X. Example commands: show profiles name="profile 1" interface="Wireless Network Connection"; show profiles name=profile2; show profiles. Applies To: Windows 7, Windows Server 2008 R2 (archived).
facts: show profiles name=<프로필> key=clear: 관리자 권한이 있으면 평문 키 표시
name 없으면 프로필 이름만 나열
표시 정보에 Security settings(Security key) 포함

sources.title: Find your saved Wi-Fi passwords on iPhone or iPad - Apple Support
sources.body: In iOS 16, iPadOS 16.1, and later, you can use your passcode, Face ID, or Touch ID to see and copy Wi-Fi passwords. For your current network: In the Settings app, tap Wi-Fi. Find the Wi-Fi network that you're currently using. Tap the Info button. Tap the Password field. Use your passcode, Face ID, or Touch ID to unlock and reveal the password. For previously saved networks: In the Settings app, tap Wi-Fi. Tap Edit in the upper-right corner. Use your passcode, Face ID, or Touch ID to unlock and reveal networks that your device previously joined. Tap the Info button next to a network with a lock icon. Tap the Password field to reveal it. In iOS 18, you can also use the Passwords app to find, copy, and share Wi-Fi passwords for networks that you previously joined: open Passwords, select Wi-Fi, choose your network, tap the Password field.
facts: iOS 16, iPadOS 16.1 이상
설정 > Wi-Fi > 정보 버튼 > 암호 필드 > 암호·Face ID·Touch ID

sources.title: If you need help with your Wi‑Fi password - Apple Support
sources.body: Password-protected networks display a lock icon. Wi-Fi passwords are case-sensitive, so make sure that you're typing the correct uppercase or lowercase characters. From Mac (macOS 13 or later): choose Apple menu > System Settings, click Network in the sidebar, then click Wi-Fi on the right. Scroll down and click Advanced to open the list of known networks. Click the More button next to the network name and choose Copy Password. Alternative sources: router admin webpage or app (if you manage it), staff at public locations like libraries or hotels, labels on the router itself, router documentation, the person or company who set up your network. If a network password has changed, forget the network and rejoin it, which will prompt you to enter the current password.
facts: macOS 13 이상: 시스템 설정 > 네트워크 > Wi-Fi > 고급 > 더보기 > 암호 복사

sources.title: Find and share your Wi-Fi password on Mac - Apple Support
sources.body: Find a Wi-Fi password: Go to the Passwords app on your Mac. Click Wi-Fi in the sidebar (click the sidebar button if you don't see the sidebar). Select a Wi-Fi network, then hold the pointer over the series of dots next to Password to show the password. You can click the dots to copy the password. Share: Make sure your Mac is unlocked and connected to the network; the other person selects your network in Wi-Fi settings; click Share Password. Or click Show Network QR Code, which friends and family can scan to join the network. Direct sharing requires devices within Bluetooth and Wi-Fi range, not using Personal Hotspot, and added to each other's contacts. Applies to macOS 27, macOS Tahoe 26, macOS Sequoia 15.
facts: 암호 앱 > Wi-Fi > 네트워크 선택 > 점 위에 포인터

sources.title: View the information stored in a keychain on Mac - Apple Support
sources.body: In the Keychain Access app on your Mac, select a keychain in the Keychains list. Double-click the item you want to view. In the Get Info window's Attributes pane, to see a password, select Show password, then enter the password for the keychain that contains the item. The Access Control pane lets you set access requirements. Note: Apple recommends using the Passwords app to manage passwords, passkeys, and verification codes on your Mac.

sources.title: Share Your Wi-Fi Password Without Typing It | Samsung Singapore
sources.body: Navigate to Settings > Connections > Wi-Fi. Select the Settings icon next to your connected network. Tap QR code to display the shareable code. Have guests scan the QR code with their Android phones. They'll automatically connect upon tapping the resulting link. Your device must already be connected to that network in order to share it with someone else. Make sure your device software and apps are updated.
facts: 설정 > 연결 > Wi-Fi > 연결된 네트워크 옆 설정(톱니) > QR 코드

sources.title: How to share your Wi-Fi password on a Galaxy phone | Samsung Gulf
sources.body: Open Settings app, go to Connections > Wi-Fi, ensure connected to the network you want to share, tap the Settings icon next to your network name, select the QR code option, have guests scan the code with their Android phone for automatic connection. Your Galaxy device must be connected to the Wi-Fi network before generating the QR code. Both devices need the latest software versions. When it may fail: guest's device running older Android versions may not support this feature; network restrictions or security settings on your router could prevent the QR code from functioning; restart your router if issues occur.
facts: QR 생성 전 해당 Wi-Fi 연결 필요
